entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Raphael S. Ndingi Mwana a'Nzeki was a Kenyan bishop of the Roman Catholic Church who served as archbishop of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Nairobi in Kenya. He also served as the bishop of Machakos and Nakuru.
